lines.text: It’s project time! Build a quiz game on a topic you love: at least five checkable questions, a score that starts at 0, feedback after every answer, and a final message with the score.
Make a quiz on any topic you love: maths, animals, space, cricket… At least five questions, a score, and feedback after every answer.
Write clear questions with one right answer.
Short answers (a number or one word) are easiest to check.
Celebrate correct answers with a sound and a message.
For wrong answers, tell the player the right answer so they learn.
At the end, say the final score with join.
Add a special message for a perfect score!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
